string.text: Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which in turn improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate
Increases muzzle velocity, thus improving the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Improved muzzle brake
Significantly reduces muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the critical parts of the firearm improves its durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Recoil damper
Modifications to the gas operating system help to reduce felt recoil.
Rubberized grip
Provides better grip for the hand.
Tactical device
Insight AN/PEQ-16a tactical block combines the functions of a laser sight and a tactical flashlight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
40 round magazine
Extended PMAG 40 AR magazine decreases the number of reloads in combat.
60 round magazine
High capacity SureFire MAG5-60 significantly facilitates fighting against superior enemy forces.
Improved feeding mechanism
Reduces the number of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Shock-absorbing buttstock
The telescopic buttstock with an internal shock-absorbing mechanism significantly reduces felt recoil and makes firing more comfortable.
Assault set
Special brackets allow the installation of an under-barrel grenade launcher, and the tactical handle reduces the recoil felt when firing.
Balanced bolt
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces the muzzle climb and reduces the number of weapon malfunctions.
More durable bolt
Reinforced steel bolt carrier significantly increases the number of times the bolt can cycle without maintenance.
Hammer release delay device
Makes firing more stable by decreasing the rate of fire, helps save ammunition. Decreases barrel heat up, thus increases weapon's lifespan.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Lightweight forend
Reducec the weight of the weapon.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
More durable parts
Parts made of refractory metals that are extraordinarily resistant to heat and wear improve durability.
Sniper set

A comprehensive redesign, including a longer barrel and a redesigned gas-operated mechanism housed within the forend, increases muzzle velocity while improving accuracy. By extending the lethal range, this modification makes the assault rifle suitable for use as an entry-level sniper rifle.
Lightweight stock
Reduces weight, allowing to carry extra ammo or an additional artifact into a raid.
Recoil reduction system
Decreases felt recoil, making the shooting more comfortable and accurate.
